about: Leader abilities for the tactical battle: one row DT_LEAD_<statueId> per statue whose wiki leader ability has at least one effect with verified units. abilityName is the ABI_LEAD_NAME_<statueId> label key. paramLv1_0/paramLv10_0 are per-mille at ability level 1 and 10 (the client lerps between them); paramLv*_1 is the Jjs.StatueType for the *_STYPE_* affects. giveLimit -1 = unlimited (0 would never apply). Rows DT_MIND_<stat>_<rarity> are the Mind abilities (ours; 3.12 Minds act only through ability rows). Rows DT_AST_<kind><tier> are the assist abilities (docs/research/19-assists.md). Rows DT_MLINK_<stat>_<n> are the Mind link abilities (docs/research/26-links-and-skills.md).

sources.source: Gamerch JoJo DR wiki (Wayback Machine snapshot)
sources.note: leader-ability numbers only (Lv1 value and the MAX value as Lv10); per-record archive URLs are in local/wiki-raw/gamerch/statues.json

sources.note: leader-ability numbers only, for statues the Wayback dump lacks (build_leader_abilities.py --research): the page leader name equals the ABI_LEAD_NAME label and its title gives the rarity and type. A line without (MAX ...) gives Lv10 = Lv1. DT_LEAD_3001_03 is uncertain (M): its +15% has no MAX on the page, and ShoutWiki oldid 3832 shows +15% as the MAX Lv. value, so Lv1 may be lower.

sources.source: Diamond Records Wiki (ShoutWiki) (MAX leader values, research pass)
sources.note: research-b43/assists: the Reversal-era (tactical) MAX Lv. leader value of the statue page that the statue's stats cite, for statues no Gamerch page gives; the page prints no Lv1, so Lv1 = Lv10 = the MAX value (ours). Lines without a tactical affect are not used.
units, slots and conditions read in the client code; see scripts/K_abilities.py header
ability ids DT_LEAD_<statueId> are ours (the server sends the same ids); where the wiki MAX value is missing or implausible Lv10 = Lv1
Mind abilities DT_MIND_<HP|ATK|DEF>_<rarity> are ours (tools/content/build_mind_abilities.py): Lv1 2/3/5/8% by rarity 1-4, doubled at Lv10

Assist abilities DT_AST_<KIND><tier> (tools/content/build_assist_abilities.py): names are the game's ABI_AST_<KIND><tier>_N label keys; values per tier follow the ShoutWiki assist numbers where it has them (HP 5/6/10%, ATK 4/6/8/20%, DEF 6/8%, damage dealt 3/5/7/18%), the rest are ours; Lv10 = Lv1
Mind link abilities DT_MLINK_<stat>_<n> (tools/content/build_mind_links.py): named by the game's ABI_MIND_LINK_NAME_<nnn> labels; +3/5/8% for 2/3/4 linked Minds (ours); Lv10 = Lv1
